probe.effect: You can have up to 2 probes in space at the same time.
Moving onto asteroids gives 1 publicity; leaving asteroids no longer costs 1 extra movement.
You can land on a planet's moon instead of the planet; same cost.

telescope.effect: During a Scan, you can mark a signal in a sector adjacent to Earth instead of marking Earth's sector.
During a Scan, pay 1 publicity to mark an extra signal in a sector with Mercury.
During a Scan, discard one card from hand to mark an extra signal in a matching sector.
During a Scan, pay 1 energy to launch a probe, or gain 1 movement.

computer.effect: A new computer space: 2 VP on the upper space when data is placed there; the lower space gives 1 credit.
A new computer space: 2 VP upper; the lower space gives 1 energy.
A new computer space: 2 VP upper; the lower space gives 1 card.
A new computer space: 2 VP upper; the lower space gives 2 publicity.

tech_board.first_taker_note: A 2-point tile sits on top of each stack; the first player to take from a stack discards it and scores 2 points.

rotation_counter.note: Three labelled spaces: yellow ring 1, orange rings 1+2, teal rings 1+2+3. The counter advances one position each time the solar system rotates and then cycles. The starting space is the one the rulebook calls "the marked space" (read as ring 1).

neutral_milestone_box.note: Printed next to the 20-point milestone: number of nonplayer markers by player count (4: none, 3: one, 1-2: two per milestone).

zones.printed: Buy a card: pay 3 publicity, take 1 card (free action). The box is drawn beside spaces 3 to 5 but the action is available at any publicity of 3 or more (owner note).
Research a tech: pay 6 publicity, rotate the solar system, take a tech (main action).
